feeds.title: Yorkshire Food Guide
feeds.description: The Yorkshire Food Guide is a trusted online guide to getting the best out of Yorkshire's dining destinations. Promoting the best in the business all under one umbrella, to inspire foodies on where to eat across the region. Keep up to date with the latest news, reviews, foodie events and exclusive offers.

feeds.title: Yorkshire Pudd Blog
feeds.description: Chris is the founder of and creative force behind the Yorkshire Pudd blog. He is the reigning World Yorkshire Pudding Champion, Star of ITV's Food Glorious Food, ITV's Country House Sunday, and has appeared on BBC's The One Show. Chris is a regular contributor to BBC Radio Leeds.

feeds.title: Jen's Food Blog
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Jen, I'm originally from Leeds but moved to the North Sheffield area and I LOVE food - cooking it and of course, eating it, and I LOVE the joy it brings people. So here I am sharing my homemade, easy-to-make, and healthy recipes and eating out experiences mainly within Sheffield and surrounding areas, but occasionally venturing further afield!

feeds.title: Real Yorkshire Tours Blog » Eat
feeds.description: A blog to promote all things Yorkshire, reviewing Yorkshire hotels, restaurants, and bars, the best of Yorkshire Culture as well as Yorkshire history. I'm Tim Barber and since 2015 I have been running Real Yorkshire Tours - offering chauffeur-guided small group tours for visitors to Yorkshire.

feeds.title: Yorkshire Appetite Food Tours Blog
feeds.description: Yorkshire Appetite is based in Harrogate and was started to help visitors experience a great few hours finding out more about our towns and why both have been known as the happiest place to live in the UK in the last few years. Locally owned and run, Yorkshire Appetite wanted to take visitors on a journey around our beautiful towns of Harrogate and York and entertain them - finding out about the key historical and cultural sites - and in between, enjoy what all visitors to Yorkshire enjoy - food and drink.

feeds.title: York On A Fork
feeds.description: I launched this site in 2014 as a response to continued, strong suggestions that I should start a food blog. During my decade or so working in financial services, I realized I was spending an increasing amount of time either booking restaurants for team events or answering emails from colleagues with queries about where to eat out in York.

feeds.title: Leeds Indie Food
feeds.description: Our mission is to make Leeds the UK's go-to city for gastronomy by celebrating food and drink traders and allowing the spirit of creativity, growth, and experimentation to thrive. We believe indie hospitality brands form the social and cultural fabric of Leeds, and we work every day to give them the recognition and support they deserve.

feeds.title: British Food History » Yorkshire
feeds.description: Read articles about Yorkshire food. Welcome to British Food: A History, my blog that attempts to tell the history of Britain through its food and food cultures. In addition to all the history, I also want to provide plenty of recipes to try that actually work - even if sometimes the ingredients are a little too strange to our modern tastes.

feeds.title: Squidbeak Blog
feeds.description: Squidbeak is all about finding the best places to eat in Yorkshire. We write as we find and report honestly on what we find. We celebrate the best and if a place doesn't come up to scratch, it doesn't get in. We visit anonymously and pay for all the meals we review for Squidbeak.

feeds.title: Yorkshire.com » Food and Drink
feeds.description: Stay, Discover, Eat & Do in Beautiful Yorkshire. Yorkshire.com (International) Ltd has been doing business as 'Welcome to Yorkshire' since September 2022, from headquarters in York.

feeds.title: Yorkshire Dales Food and Drink Festival Blog
feeds.description: Everyone is welcome at the Yorkshire Dales Food & Drink Festival, and we endeavor to take reasonable action to ensure our festival is accessible for all. Our team both in the office and in the field will do their utmost to ensure everyone has a great experience. We view the usual facilities expected at events such as disabled parking, toilets, free Carer tickets, and easy access viewing as a given.
